| [AM.MAN.DEX.TACTILE.POSTTRAIN.1] <a id="am-man-dex-tactile-posttrain-1"></a> | **InternW0｜Asynchronous WAM architecture · Observation-conditioned K/V editing · Multiple manipulation platforms**<br>[InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.27656v1)<br>Jisong Cai, Yao Mu, Ganlin Yang, Zhe Cao, Zhangzheng Tu, Xing Gao, Kailin Li, Xinyu Zhan, Lixin Yang, Yangkun Zhu, Haoxiang Ma, Ming Zhou, Qiaojun Yu, Yufei Xue, Liqun He, Yifei Yao, Yifan Zhu, Long Ling, Bingqi Jiang, Haoyu Guo, Xueyue Zhu, Bowen Zhou, Bin Zhao, Tianfan Xue, Chunhua Shen, Weinan Zhang<br>[Canonical paper entry](../dexterous/tactile/post-training.md#am-man-dex-tactile-posttrain-1)<br>**Tags:** `dexterous` `parallel-gripper` `wam` `asynchronous-inference` `observation-conditioned-routing` `kv-cache-editing` `action-expert` [tactile](../../topics/tactile.md) `force-feedback` `tactile-post-training` `joint-action-contact-prediction` `flow-matching` `human-video-pretraining` `cross-embodiment` `laboratory-manipulation` `real-world` `simulation` | InternW0 asynchronously decouples slow video prediction from fast action generation: the latest image drives a K/V editor that adapts cached predictive context for the next action chunk, avoiding full video recomputation at each action update.<br>**Evaluation scope:** AE means Action Expert, not autoencoder. Heterogeneous pretraining uses about 7,200 hours of robot and human egocentric data, including about 275 hours of EgoLab: robot trajectories supervise video and action flow matching, while human videos supervise future video only, without requiring tactile labels. Contact-aware post-training extends the action-side inputs with measured force/tactile history and the targets with joint action–contact prediction. Only history observed before generation is supplied; future contact channels are noised and denoised jointly with actions. Action channels execute, so predicted contact must not be assumed to be a directly issued force-control target. The slow video expert exposes layerwise K/V; current DINOv3 image features query and residually edit a chunk-specific context view without cumulatively rewriting the base cache or updating weights online. Asynchronous scheduling and observation-guided routing follow AHA-WAM. Real experiments comprise four tasks with dual parallel-gripper arms and five-stage pipetting with a 20-DoF dexterous hand on a 7-DoF arm; the hand model is unspecified, and paired same-task cross-hand transfer is not established. Each of the five tasks has 15 trials. Pipetting achieves 65.3% ordered-subtask progress, with 46.7% reaching the final stage, rather than 65.3% full-episode success. RTX 5090D latency of 60.73 ms / 16.47 Hz measures only the action critical path, excluding asynchronous video prediction. Official code and Base, RoboTwin-clean and LIBERO weight links are public; the RoboTwin-clean .pt listing was verified. The repository explicitly excludes the paper’s force/tactile, real-robot and laboratory assets; downloadable tactile post-training data, specialized weights and real-robot interfaces have not been verified. | arXiv v1 / 2026 | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.27656v1) · [Project](https://internrobotics.github.io/internw0/) · [Code](https://github.com/InternRobotics/InternW0) · [Assets](https://huggingface.co/collections/InternRobotics/nternw0) | Initial reading<br>2026-11-04 |
